description: Convert PDF bank statements into transactions that arrive with a pass/fail reconciliation verdict.
name: com.bankstatementsheet/bank-statement-sheet-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Optional API key from bankstatementsheet.com/dashboard. Without it the free anonymous tier applies (5 conversions/month, Excel and CSV).
environmentVariables.name: BSS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Directories PDFs may be read from (path-delimited). Defaults to the working directory and ~/Downloads.
environmentVariables.name: BSS_ALLOWED_DIRS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum PDF size in MB before upload is refused locally. Default 50.
environmentVariables.name: BSS_MAX_FILE_MB

title: Bank Statement Sheet
